{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ankarax''' was a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creature native to [[Fhost]]. It was frequently used to drag carts and wagons. The citizens of Fhost also used its meat for food, and its hide for [[Leather/Legends|leather]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

In [[Farpoint]], the creatures were so common that pedestrians had to be careful not to step in ankarax droppings. The animals were also well-known for their toughness. [[Khedryn Faal]] described The [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole's]] bartender as "tough as an ankarax."<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
